title: Calvaria SMP
description: A little Minecraft SMP for builders & other creative people alike,
body:
🏛️ Calvaria SMP | 16+ Java Survival Community

A long-term semi-vanilla Minecraft server focused on building, community, and permanence.

• No world resets
• Java Edition
• Builder-focused community
• Casual, low-drama environment
• Optional client-side mods only

Server features:

Simple Voice Chat
Audio Player
Vein Miner
Tree Harvester
Mob & Player Heads
Armor Poser
Small QoL improvements

Opened January 28, 2026 and intended to stay online permanently. Build large projects without worrying about wipes or grief-heavy gameplay.

Join here:
https://discord.gg/vxXaUh4w6w

Application requirement:
Submit an original creation when applying. Minecraft builds, artwork, and other creative work are accepted.
